CFML Language Reference: Functions

Replace

Replaces the first occurrence, or every occurrence, of a substring with another string. The search is case-sensitive.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Replace(string, substring1, substring2 [, scope ])

Parameters

string
The string to work on.
substring1
The text to look for.
substring2
The text to put in its place. May be empty, which removes substring1.
scope
Optional. "ONE" replaces only the first occurrence (the default); "ALL" replaces every occurrence.

Returns

The string with the replacements made.

Usage

Forgetting "ALL" is the classic bug: by default only the first match is replaced. Use ReplaceNoCase to ignore case, ReplaceList to make several different replacements in one call, and REReplace for pattern-based replacements.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Text = "The Web is the future. The Web is now.">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Original: #Text#</P>
<P>ONE: #Replace(Text, "Web", "Internet")#</P>
<P>ALL: #Replace(Text, "Web", "Internet", "ALL")#</P>
<P>Case matters: #Replace(Text, "the", "a", "ALL")#</P>
<P>Removing: #Replace("555-12-34", "-", "", "ALL")#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ReplaceNoCase, ReplaceList, REReplace, Find
